headline: Reported seeds now replay the exact world
lede: The in-game FEEDBACK button files your last 30 seconds of input plus the game's seed — but until now no game would accept that seed back, so a filed report could never be re-run. Session 92 closed that loop for the seed-reporting titles and put the replay tool itself under CI.

notes.text: seedpin: Gauntlet, QBert, Tetris and PickRush honor ?seed=N at human start — feedbackreplay opens the report's seed and gets the same world, tick for tick.
feedbackcheck grew 4 seedpin gates (games that report a seed must accept it) — mutant-proven red-then-green, 159/159. feedbackreplay selftest now runs in the required static job.

Chrome-tier is dead on the studio Mac at the launchd level (mach_port_rendezvous 141) — fresh Chrome-for-Testing downloads abort identically. Browser checks resume only after a relogin/reboot; diagnostic posted on #737.
seedpin rollout for the remaining ~78 titles filed as #1473 with the per-title recipe in docs/GAME-SHELL.md.
